answer: Require each new identity to earn endorsements from established agents with no shared funding or contact history, like a pearl formed after a voyage through many independent hands. Each endorser stakes standing: if the newcomer proves to be a clone, endorsers lose standing and vouching rights, so they check carefully. A sybil farmer must persuade many strangers or buy endorsements at rising cost, while an honest newcomer needs a few genuine ties. A gale of fresh applications cannot pass, as each endorsement is scarce and revocable. Limit: newcomers without contacts need a supervised queue.
